purpose: Classify every artifact in this package by the channel order that conditioned it, so legacy-BGR and (hypothetical) corrected-RGB material can never be confused or mixed.
corrected_rgb_directory_note: No corrected_rgb/ directory exists in this package because no authentic corrected-RGB artifact exists. An empty directory was deliberately not invented.

artifacts.detail: MW_CURRENT, MW_CURRENT_L04, MW_CURRENT_L10, MW_CURRENT_MINUS_PREVIOUS and MW_TWO_FRAME_CONCAT rows are BGR-conditioned. LINEAR_CURRENT_PIXEL rows are true-RGB. LAST_SEEN, CONSTANT_VELOCITY, TIME_ONLY and TRAINING_MEAN are pixel-independent. Targets are pixel-independent.
every estimand derives from the sealed lock above
PIXEL_BASELINE blocks are true-RGB; the five MW_* blocks are BGR-conditioned
the captured PNGs are true scene RGB; the swap happens only at model-input preprocessing time and was never serialized
FIR labels come from server-side world coordinates
authority 7.4 requires P0/RVE to read source RGB and forbids coupling to the model preprocessing path
